scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename yt-to-mp3-capture-firefox-{version}.zip && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename yt-to-mp3-capture-chromium-{version}.zip
scripts.start:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
